test_hermescli_try_launch_chrome_debug: test the HermesCLI._try_launch_chrome_debug method to auto-launch Chrome with CDP debug flags on Windows
test_windows_launch_uses_browser_on_path: test that HermesCLI._try_launch_chrome_debug finds Chrome via shutil.which on Windows
test_windows_launch_falls_back_to_instal: test that HermesCLI._try_launch_chrome_debug falls back to common Windows Chrome install directories
test_assert_chrome_debug_cmd_flags: test that the auto-launch Chrome command includes all required CDP flags like remote-debugging-port and user-data-dir
test_subprocess_popen_start_new_session: test that the Chrome debug subprocess is launched with start_new_session enabled
